_meta.purpose: Register of source pages that contain a FORM. Forms are deferred from the master importer and handled later via the AEM Forms -> Adaptive Form JSON path. This register tracks WHERE forms appear so no form page is missed during migration.
_meta.handling: Forms are NOT converted by block parsers. When migrating any URL in this register, flag it: the form area is left as a placeholder / skipped block, and the page is queued for the Forms migration pass.

formPagesFromReport.notes: Simple contact form embedded on a campaign page (also hosts cards-benefits-grid).
Gated-modal download form on a product page.

detectionHints.note: During bulk import, ANY page (not just those above) may contain a form. The importer should DETECT forms and append the URL to detectedFormPages[] so the Forms pass covers everything.
